skills.name: Cunning Combo
skills.desc:
Press [Basic Attack] to activate:
Unleashes up to 3 strikes, dealing Physical DMG.

skills.name: Do As I Please
skills.desc: After using a Special Attack, EX Special Attack, Chain Attack, or Ultimate, Nicole can reload, and her Basic Attack and Dash Attack are enhanced, increasing the power of her bullets.

skills.name: Speed Demon
skills.desc:
Press [Dodge] to activate:
A rapid dodge.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.
Drag the joystick to dodge, then hold [Dodge] to reload while dodging, enhancing Basic Attacks and Dash Attacks up to 8 times.

skills.name: Jack in the Box
skills.desc:
When dragging the joystick during a dodge, press [Basic Attack]:
Dashes in the target direction and strikes nearby enemies, dealing Physical DMG.
When not dragging the joystick during a dodge, press [Basic Attack]:
Vaults backward and launches a ranged strike against enemies in front, dealing Physical DMG.
Automatically reloads after the attack to enhance her Basic Attack and Dash Attack, up to 8 times.

skills.name: Diverted Bombard
skills.desc:
Press [Basic Attack] during a Perfect Dodge to activate:
Dodge backwards and send a ranged strike at enemies in front, dealing Ether DMG.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.
Automatically reloads after the attack to enhance Basic Attack and Dash Attack up to 8 times.

skills.name: Emergency Bombard
skills.desc:
When the on-field character is launched, press [Assist] to activate:
Dodge backwards and send a ranged strike at enemies in front, dealing Ether DMG.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.
Automatically reloads after the attack to enhance Basic Attack and Dash Attack up to 8 times.

skills.name: The Hare Strikes Back!
skills.desc:
When the character on field is about to be attacked, press [Assist] to activate:
Parries the enemy's attack, dealing massive Daze.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

skills.name: Window of Opportunity
skills.desc:
Press [Basic Attack] after a Defensive Assist to activate:
Charge forward and bombard enemies, dealing Ether DMG.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

skills.name: Sugarcoated Bullet
skills.desc:
Press [Special Attack] to activate:
Unleashes a ranged strike against enemies in front, dealing Ether DMG.
Anti-Interrupt level is increased while using this skill.
Automatically reloads after the attack to enhance Basic Attack and Dash Attack up to 8 times.

skills.name: Stuffed Sugarcoated Bullet
skills.desc:
With enough Energy, press [EX Special Attack] to activate:
A powerful ranged strike, generating an energy field that pulls enemies towards its center to deal Ether DMG.
Hold [EX Special Attack] down to charge up this attack, during which a small energy field is generated at the muzzle as Energy is consumed, dealing bonus DMG to enemies nearby.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.
A Quick Assist is triggered when this skill hits an enemy.
Automatically reloads after the attack to enhance Basic Attack and Dash Attack up to 8 times.

skills.name: Ether Shellacking
skills.desc:
When a Chain Attack is triggered, select the character to activate:
Unleashes a powerful ranged strike at enemies in a small area, generating an energy field that pulls enemies towards its center to deal Ether DMG.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.
A Quick Assist is triggered when this skill hits an enemy.
Automatically reloads after the attack to enhance Basic Attack and Dash Attack up to 8 times.

skills.name: Ether Grenade
skills.desc:
When Decibel Rating is at Maximum, press [Ultimate] to activate:
Unleashes a powerful ranged strike at enemies in a small area, generating an energy field that pulls enemies towards its center to deal Ether DMG.
When using this skill, other squad members recover 10 Energy.
The next character to switch in gains an additional 20 Energy.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.
A Quick Assist is triggered when this skill hits an enemy.
Automatically reloads after the attack to enhance Basic Attack and Dash Attack up to 8 times.

skills.name: Mechanical Case
skills.desc:
After hitting an enemy with a Special Attack, EX Special Attack, Chain Attack, or Ultimate, Nicole can reload, enhancing her Basic Attack and Dash Attack. When her enhanced bullets or Energy Field hits an enemy, the target's DEF is reduced by 20% for 3.5s.
*Stats shown are at Base level.

skills.name: Hare of Many Burrows
skills.desc:
When another character in your squad shares the same Attribute or Faction:
When Nicole's Core Passive: Mechanical Case applies a debuff to an enemy, all squad members deal 25% more Ether DMG to the target for 3.5s.

cons.name: Supercharged Bomb
cons.desc: The DMG and the Anomaly Buildup inflicted by Nicole's EX Special Attack increases by 16%. For each additional 0.1s of charging when Nicole activates her EX Special Attack, the duration of the energy field created at the target location increases by 0.15s

cons.name: Charging Device
cons.desc: Nicole recovers 5 Energy when Core Passive: Mechanical Case's debuff is triggered. This effect can trigger once every [ ]s.

cons.name: A Hare's Cunning
cons.desc: Basic Attack, Dodge, Assist, Special Attack, and Chain Attack Lv. +2

cons.name: Field Expansion
cons.desc: When Nicole uses her EX Special Attack, Chain Attack, or Ultimate, the diameter of the energy field generated at the target location is increased by 3m.

cons.name: Industry Star
cons.desc: Basic Attack, Dodge, Assist, Special Attack, and Chain Attack Lv. +2

cons.name: Corrupting Energy Field
cons.desc: When Nicole's energy fields deal DMG to an enemy, all squad member's CRIT Rate against that enemy increases by 1.5%, stacking up to 10 times, and lasting 12s. The duration of each stack is calculated separately.
